{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for thousands separators in revenue
print("First few values of revenue:")
print(sales['revenue'].head(10))

# Check if any revenue values contain commas
has_commas = sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f"Number of revenue entries with commas: {has_commas.sum()}")

# Check for the QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}")

# Check channel distribution
print("Channel distribution:")
print(sales['channel'].value_counts())

# Check customer_segment distribution
print("Customer segment distribution:")
print(sales['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Check for conversion rates by channel
print("Conversion rate by channel:")
print(sales.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean())"}
